name: cameld
description: cameld - merges duplicate Strava recordings of the same outing without losing data.
author: Max Hogan
//typescript: Pinned to 6.x, not the latest 7.x: typescript-eslint 8.71 declares peer typescript '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0', so TS 7 (the Go rewrite with an incompatible JS API) would break linting and vue-tsc. 6.0.3 is the newest release typescript-eslint accepts. Dependabot ignores the typescript major. Revisit when typescript-eslint ships TS 7 support.
//vitest: Pinned to the 4.x line, matching amber. Dependabot ignores the vitest and @vitest/coverage-v8 majors until the whole toolchain is moved deliberately.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,magenta "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run typecheck -w e2e && npm run typecheck -w relay
